agent_priors_used: Local-continuation / path-dependence prior (general agent prior, NOT SPIDER evidence): agents tend to refine the last local question because prior output is salient; a global director must periodically ask whether a thread's immediate children are globally the most valuable problems rather than locally available ones.

Measurement-first prior (general, NOT SPIDER evidence): when an instrument has repeatedly failed by construction (empty accept regions, controls that cannot fire, arithmetic ceilings), more estimator/threshold work has low marginal value until the instrument itself is repaired; a repair is often cheaper than another arm.

Single-repair-of-a-shared-prerequisite prior (general, NOT SPIDER evidence): when one missing capability blocks N downstream experiments across lanes, repair it once in its owning lane instead of re-attempting it inside every consumer; otherwise each consumer pays a full cycle to rediscover the same defect.

Repeated-identical-failure prior (general, NOT SPIDER evidence): several consecutive invalid designs of the same shape on the same substrate are evidence about the design and the substrate class, not about the world; changing the measured object is often the necessary move.

Shipped-path-demonstration prior (general software/agent prior, NOT SPIDER evidence): a capability demonstrated only in a research harness cannot be assumed to transfer to the product kernel; the executable round trip must be shown on the shipped path before expensive external benchmarks.

Discriminating-control prior (general measurement prior, NOT SPIDER evidence): a certificate that can only detect absence (substrate present) must additionally be shown to fire in the treatment arm (treatment can differ from comparator), or a null result is uninterpretable.

allocation.rationale: C-LLM-INHERIT is the only claim in the registry at BLOCKED, and EXP-PRODUCT-37385633334 (audit PASS) source-verified why: the shipped kernel has no distill_parameterized(), distill() hardcodes confidence=0.5 while resolve() requires min_confidence=0.8 so nothing can ever resolve EXECUTABLE, and A-SPIDER is given the same TF-IDF retrieval as B-RETRIEVAL. This is the decisive precondition of the program's integrated causal chain and is cheaper to repair than the credential. Until the treatment arm is live and demonstrably differentiable, C-LLM-INHERIT, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY and the product half of C-PARAM-INHERIT cannot be measured at all. This is why the Director does not let Product execute another external comparison yet.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: The program is between waves: the last decided experiments are from 2026-09-27 (graph/physics/product/intel) and 2026-10-05 (frontier/product/physics), and the snapshot shows only two lane transactions actually alive -- Runtime with FROZEN EXP-RUNTIME-36293257855 (portfolio mandate present, must be completed under its frozen design) and Intel with PREFREEZE EXP-INTEL-37385640031 (portfolio mandate present, pre-freeze and therefore supersedable). Graph, Physics, Product and Frontier are IDLE with no active transaction. The single most decision-changing fact in the whole Codex is not a new claim: EXP-PRODUCT-37385633334 (audit PASS, 2026-10-05) source-verified that the SHIPPED kernel cannot execute an inherited mechanism at all -- distill() hardcodes confidence=0.5, resolve() defaults min_confidence=0.8 and returns EXPLORE/bound_action=None below it, and distill_parameterized() does not exist -- so the C-LLM-INHERIT treatment arm has no contrast with its own retrieval baseline by construction and no benchmark can mean anything until this is repaired. That is the precondition under the integrated chain (observation -> parameterized mechanism -> executable binding in the shipped kernel -> applicability/freshness decision -> real external agent action -> lower end-to-end successful-task cost) that the program audit already named as the missing proof. Everything else is subordinate: C-PARAM-INHERIT is EXPERIMENTAL but its shipped path is not demonstrated; C-MEAS-VALID is the strongest infrastructural claim and has a bounded VALIDATED instrument (EXP-RUNTIME-36129163700) whose single untested step is simultaneous author- and transport-generalization; C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY and C-PRODUCT-ECON are HYPOTHESIS/EXPERIMENTAL with no real-agent cost curve; C-WEB-DYNAMICS remains HYPOTHESIS after 84 experiments that are almost all synthetic or measurement-invalid; C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE and C-DELTA-REPAIR are blocked or downstream. I therefore treated its candidate_directions as a restatement of each lane's inherited local handoff rather than as reconnaissance, and cross-checked each against the snapshot, codex/index.json and codex/claim_state.json before using it. Effect on decisions: (a) I ADOPTED the Frontier candidate because its own parent packet (EXP-FRONTIER-37385647440) source-verified that every admitted item sat at hop 0 or 1, so the cost question was never exercised at depth -- changing the measured object from a stationarity label to a hop-depth cost-scaling law is a genuine, decision-changing move; (b) I ADOPTED the Product candidate's kernel-liveness diagnosis (it matches the audit's source-verified kernel defect) while re-scoping the deliverable to the arm-differentiation certificate rather than a sixth re-run of the same readiness gate; (c) I ADOPTED the Graph candidate only in its two-path, measurement-validity form, because it repairs the actual gate-0 extraction failure of EXP-GRAPH-36314193643 rather than retuning a threshold; (d) I ADOPTED Intel's Part 1 break-even determination because it needs no new corpus and its evidence is already hash-pinned, and I explicitly declined Part 2's census for this cycle; (e) I DECLINED the Physics candidate: although detailed and technically a redesign (categorical change class, mechanism-free required control, explicit branch precedence), it remains the same HTTP-signature observable on the same query-parameter substrate whose mechanism-free constant already beat the treatment, and the Scout supplied no external evidence of a materially new observable. inherited_next_question: This packet's most valuable result is not its MEASUREMENT_INVALID label, which is a correct and cheap substrate diagnosis, but a bounded defect in the frozen certificate itself that the producer and the auditor both saw only partially: the gate as frozen can certify that SUBSTRATE IS PRESENT but it can never certify that the TREATMENT ARM CAN DIFFER FROM ITS COMPARATOR, so this design would burn its entire remaining budget and still return zero information even after every named prerequisite is satisfied. I verified that at source rather than inferring it. spec.json A-SPIDER names the mechanism registry 'as currently implemented in src/spider/kernel.py', and prereg.md section 4 requires induction by distill_parameterized(); no such function exists in the 132-line kernel at HEAD, which offers only a literal distill(). Worse, the literal path is closed by construction: distill() hardcodes confidence=0.5 (src/spider/kernel.py line 90), resolve() defaults min_confidence=0.8 (line 59) and returns Resolution(ResolutionStatus.EXPLORE, ..., bound_action=None) whenever the best candidate falls below that threshold (line 114), so no mechanism produced by the shipped kernel's own distill() can EVER resolve to EXECUTABLE and no bound_action is ever produced. Since spec.json also gives A-SPIDER the SAME TF-IDF Jaccard K=5 retrieval as B-RETRIEVAL for budget matching, a fully passing readiness certificate would leave A-SPIDER indistinguishable from its own strong baseline by construction, and the frozen falsifier would then report a vacuous SUPPORTS or FALSIFIES about a comparison with no treatment contrast in it. That is a design defect of the same class as the parent packet's frozen-rule defect, and it is cheaper to fix than the credential: it is one more pre-execution control, not one more arm. THE NEXT QUESTION, which must not be executed on the current substrate and must not be a fifth re-run of the same gate: does a real external LLM agent at identical model, tools and budget benefit from SPIDER's inherited mechanisms beyond a retrieval baseline, once the experiment is made arm-differentiation-valid BEFORE any expensive arm runs -- concretely, (1) a FOURTH mandatory pre-execution certificate check, the treatment-arm liveness control, which must be SHOWN TO FIRE on a synthetic fixture before the gate passes: a known-positive round trip in which an induction observation distils to a mechanism that resolves to EXECUTABLE with a non-null bound_action and executes, AND a known-negative round trip in which a wrong-parameter or out-of-support binding is refused with a recorded reason, because a certificate that can only detect absence cannot detect a degenerate treatment; (2) the shipped kernel must be able to execute an inherited mechanism at all, so distill_parameterized() must exist and the distill-to-resolve confidence path must be closed or deliberately widened, with the resulting EXECUTABLE rate on the induction set itself reported as a gate quantity rather than discovered during the arms; (3) the PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY control must additionally demonstrate-firing on the inherited path, so the cost model's retrieval_calls, verification_calls and repair_attempts terms are shown to increment on a mechanism execution and not only on a scripted trajectory; (4) freeze.json must bind a task-bank hash and a src/spider/kernel.py hash, or a documented preregistered substitute, so substrate is immutable at freeze instead of discovered post hoc, which is this program's fourth-plus recorded sighting of the freeze-cannot-bind-code defect and the direct cause of this packet's check-2 failure being unreconcilable; and (5) the falsifier must be rewritten so that A-SPIDER and B-RETRIEVAL cannot tie by construction, for example by requiring a non-zero rate of tasks in which the bound mechanism was actually the executed action, so a retrieval-shaped A-SPIDER arm is detected as the null it is rather than scored as a result. If no model credential can be provisioned, the correct disposition is to fail at DESIGN with the exact provisioning receipt named, not to re-freeze and re-execute this gate a sixth time: a deterministic pre-DESIGN probe of the four named prerequisites (credential present and returning 200 within 30s, playwright and httpx importable, a committed task bank with at least 30 mechanical verifiers, and a kernel that resolves to EXECUTABLE) costs minutes and has now replaced a full cycle five times over. This question is deliberately NOT the parent handoff's identifier-level support-model question, which the binding mandate assigned to Graph and which would be a third consecutive Product packet in that basin, and it is NOT another isolation-level economics packet, because the component that decides whether the product exists has still never been measured.
